caveats: All 260 distinct URL opens were requested in this session across six groups. Opening a URL does not mean its evidence was read and interpreted.
Success means the web tool returned readable material or PDF, not proof of location/current gay cruising. PDFs require visual inspection before using their information.
No readable result may mean block, cache miss, timeout, or unavailable site; do not equate this with a nonexistent location.
An alternate source search remains necessary for candidates whose primary pages are blocked; individual candidate resolutions are not final.

Two additional original detail links were recovered from the Italy country index after checking the initially stored 260 URL list. Both returned cache misses; indexing all other candidate-specific detail links is ongoing.
